nodes.name: Sklearn Ensemble Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level public sklearn.ensemble estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above tree, boosting, histogram, and isolation-forest execution boundaries.

nodes.name: ensemble_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose covered public tree-ensemble estimator names for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed estimator-name tuple and does not inspect training data.

nodes.name: ensemble_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return the ensemble family for a public tree-ensemble estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs constant-time membership checks over fixed estimator-family sets.

nodes.name: ensemble_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return the high-level task for a public tree-ensemble estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs constant-time membership checks over fixed task sets.

nodes.name: ensemble_estimator_backend
nodes.description: Return the native or solver boundary family behind a public tree ensemble.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs constant-time membership checks over fixed backend-boundary sets.

nodes.name: ensemble_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level tree-ensemble routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns one fixed method tuple selected by estimator name.

nodes.name: ensemble_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public ensemble prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates method availability and packages references, leaving prediction execution to sklearn.

nodes.name: ensemble_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted ensemble estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: ensemble_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose a compact fitted-state summary after deferred tree, boosting, histogram, or isolation-forest work.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom counts fitted base learners or predictor stages and packages shallow documented fitted-state attributes.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 1 public tree-ensemble estimator shells over native tree, boosting, and histogram boundaries
